entities.name: Cabal City
entities.description: Capital of the Cabal in Otaria on Dominaria, notable for pit fighting; later ruined and abandoned.

entities.name: Cabal Patriarch
entities.description: Ruler of Cabal City, later exiled to Aphetto.

entities.name: Virot Maglan
entities.description: Founder of the Cabal who made a pact with Kuberr.

entities.name: Kuberr
entities.description: God who granted Maglan the power to kill by touch.

entities.name: Chainer
entities.description: Dementist who usurped the Cabal and lost control of Mirari power.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: Pit fighter who fought Chainer with the Order.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: Planeswalker who returned in 4500 AR to view the damage.

entities.name: Laquatus
entities.description: Occupant of an embassy in Cabal City.

entities.name: Braids
entities.description: Spellcaster pit fighter of the Casters' Quarter.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: Powerful object that caused the Battle for the Mirari.

entities.name: Rise of the Cabal
entities.description: Founding of the Cabal in 4050 AR.

entities.name: Aphetto
entities.description: Place the Patriarch was exiled to and where the Cabal relocated.

entities.name: Karona's War
entities.description: War in which Aphetto and the Grand Coliseum were destroyed.

events.summary: Virot Maglan pacts with Kuberr and founds the Cabal.
events.quote: Virot Maglan sealed a pact with the god Kuberr and gained the power to kill using touch

events.summary: A Krosan dragon badly damages Cabal City.
events.quote: the city was badly damaged when it was attacked by a Krosan dragon

events.summary: Chainer usurps the Cabal and exiles the Patriarch; dementia creatures overrun the city.
events.quote: Chainer usurped rulership of the Cabal and exiled the Patriarch to Aphetto

events.summary: Chainer loses control of the Mirari's power in a pit fight against Kamahl; the city is condemned and abandoned.
events.quote: the ruined city was completely abandoned by the Cabal

events.summary: After Karona's War the Cabal decays and the ruins become a refugee camp.
events.quote: The ruins of Cabal City turned into a refugee camp for cabalists

events.summary: Jeska returns to Otaria and sees the caved-in dome.
events.quote: the arena's dome had long since caved in

relations.quote: Cabal City was a city located in Otaria
from which he ran the city

relations.note: gave up allegiance to anyone else
relations.quote: all allegiance to anyone other than Kuberr
